skill.name: youtube-influencer-finder-api-skill
skill.description: Extract YouTube creator profiles, channel statistics, contact details, and social links through the BrowserAct API workflow.
skill.summary: Find YouTube creator profiles and outreach details with a BrowserAct API workflow.
skill.author: browser-act

security_audit.summary: The skill is a BrowserAct API wrapper that intentionally performs third-party network requests with a BrowserAct API key. Most markdown backtick and reconnaissance alerts are false positives, and no prompt injection attempt was found. Confirmed concerns are external API data transfer, API key disclosure guidance, local script execution, and privacy-sensitive creator contact collection.

remediation.issue: API key handling instructions encourage secret disclosure.
remediation.suggestion: Do not ask users to paste API keys into chat. Direct users to set BROWSERACT_API_KEY locally or through a managed secret store.

remediation.issue: The skill sends user queries and authorization headers to BrowserAct.
remediation.suggestion: Disclose that searches, task identifiers, and workflow results are processed by BrowserAct before the script runs.

remediation.issue: The workflow collects creator emails and social links for outreach.
remediation.suggestion: Add lawful-use, consent, and anti-spam guidance for contact data collection and campaign usage.

remediation.issue: Fallback output can print the full API task response.
remediation.suggestion: Print only required creator fields and redact operational metadata that is not needed by the user.

content.value_statement: Manual YouTube creator research is slow and inconsistent. This skill runs a BrowserAct workflow to collect channel stats, social links, and contact fields.
actual_capabilities: Runs the BrowserAct YouTube influencer workflow template from a Python script.
Accepts search keywords and an upload date filter from command arguments.
Uses BROWSERACT_API_KEY from the local environment for authentication.
Polls BrowserAct task status and reports progress until completion or timeout.
Prints returned creator profile fields such as subscribers, views, email, and social links.
limitations: Requires a BrowserAct API key and network access to BrowserAct services.
Supports only the documented upload date filters: Today, This Week, This Month, and This Year.
Result quality depends on BrowserAct workflow output and visible YouTube profile data.
Contact data use must follow platform rules, privacy laws, and outreach consent requirements.

use_cases.title: Build Campaign Shortlists
use_cases.description: Find YouTube creators in a niche and compare basic channel metrics before outreach.

use_cases.title: Research Creator Markets
use_cases.description: Collect creator profiles, countries, descriptions, and social links for market sizing.

use_cases.title: Monitor Active Channels
use_cases.description: Filter creators by recent upload windows to focus on active YouTube channels.

prompt_templates.title: Find Basic Leads
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner search with the default recent upload window.
prompt_templates.prompt: Find YouTube creators for the keyword "fitness coach" using the default upload date filter. Summarize the strongest leads.

prompt_templates.title: Filter Recent Creators
prompt_templates.scenario: Narrow results to creators who uploaded recently.
prompt_templates.prompt: Search for YouTube influencers about "budget travel" who uploaded this month. Return channel names, subscriber counts, and contact fields.

prompt_templates.title: Compare Campaign Niches
prompt_templates.scenario: Run focused research for two audience segments.
prompt_templates.prompt: Research YouTube creators for "home coffee" and "espresso setup". Group the results by niche and highlight outreach-ready channels.

prompt_templates.title: Prepare Outreach Research
prompt_templates.prompt: Find active YouTube creators for "AI productivity tools" this week. Prioritize channels with social links, email fields, and clear profile descriptions.

output_examples.input: Keyword: gaming, upload date: This Month
output_examples.output: A ranked list of gaming channels with subscriber counts, total views, recent activity, profile descriptions, and available contact links.

output_examples.input: Keyword: sustainable fashion, upload date: This Year
output_examples.output: Creator profiles grouped for outreach review, including channel links, country fields, and visible email or social contact options.

output_examples.input: Keyword: SaaS reviews, upload date: This Week
output_examples.output: A concise shortlist of active SaaS review channels with metrics and notes on whether each profile includes reachable contact information.

best_practices: Set BROWSERACT_API_KEY in the local environment before running the skill.
Use specific keywords to reduce irrelevant creator profiles and API cost.
Review contact data for lawful use before adding creators to outreach campaigns.
anti_patterns: Do not paste API keys into chat messages or shared documents.
Do not use broad keywords when a campaign requires a focused niche.
Do not send bulk outreach without consent checks and unsubscribe handling.

faq.question: Does this skill need an API key?
faq.answer: Yes. It requires BROWSERACT_API_KEY to authenticate requests to BrowserAct.

faq.question: Where does the data come from?
faq.answer: The Python script starts a BrowserAct workflow that collects YouTube creator profile data.

faq.question: Can it find email addresses?
faq.answer: It can return email fields when the BrowserAct workflow finds visible contact information.

faq.question: Can I choose a date filter?
faq.answer: Yes. The supported filters are Today, This Week, This Month, and This Year.

faq.question: Does it run fully offline?
faq.answer: No. It needs network access to BrowserAct and depends on the BrowserAct API response.

faq.question: Is the output ready for outreach?
faq.answer: The output can support outreach planning, but you must verify consent, accuracy, and legal requirements first.
